digest.component_or_area: eval spec validation and CI gating
propositions: Strict eval-spec validation currently lives only in an inline CI step in the Prompt Eval GitHub Actions workflow, not in the default pytest suite, so it does not block Gerrit Verified votes.
New packaged eval specs with datasets but missing gold_set can merge with Verified +1 when the standalone Prompt Eval workflow is the only location performing strict validation.
Moving the strict validation check into a unit test in test_eval_scorers.py ensures it runs in the default pytest suite and gates the Verified vote via gerrit-verify.yaml.
The new test must glob all packaged eval specs, assert validate_eval_spec(spec) passes for all, and additionally assert validate_eval_spec(spec, strict=True) passes for every dataset-bearing spec.
